small_resect.label: Very small gastric GIST with high-risk features: proceed to complete surgical resection pathway.

recommendation.title: Very small gastric GIST with high-risk features: proceed to complete surgical resection pathway.

options.label: Surgery
options.text: Complete resection when appropriate; use GIST-C surgical principles.

small_observe.label: Very small gastric GIST without high-risk features: periodic endoscopic or radiographic surveillance can be considered.

recommendation.title: Very small gastric GIST without high-risk features: periodic endoscopic or radiographic surveillance can be considered.

morbidity.label: Would immediate resection have significant morbidity?

resect_direct.label: Resectable GIST with minimal morbidity: complete resection, then postoperative risk-directed management.

recommendation.title: Resectable GIST with minimal morbidity: complete resection, then postoperative risk-directed management.

options.label: Complete resection
options.text: Proceed to surgery with GIST surgical principles, then GIST-3 postoperative pathway.

neo_d842v.label: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and PDGFRA D842V: use genotype-specific neoadjuvant pathway rather than imatinib.

recommendation.title: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and PDGFRA D842V: use genotype-specific neoadjuvant pathway rather than imatinib.

options.label: Genotype-directed therapy
options.text: Use the PDGFRA D842V-specific neoadjuvant option in GIST-E before reassessing surgery.

neo_sdh.label: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and SDH-deficient disease: use SDH-specific neoadjuvant options and reassess resectability.

recommendation.title: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and SDH-deficient disease: use SDH-specific neoadjuvant options and reassess resectability.

options.label: SDH-directed TKI strategy
options.text: Use source-listed SDH-deficient options and multidisciplinary reassessment.

neo_imatinib.label: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and imatinib-sensitive genotype: neoadjuvant imatinib pathway with interval response assessment.

recommendation.title: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and imatinib-sensitive genotype: neoadjuvant imatinib pathway with interval response assessment.

options.label: Neoadjuvant imatinib
options.text: Use until maximal response/appropriate surgical timing, then resect when feasible.

neo_other.label: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and nonstandard/unknown genotype: expert multidisciplinary genotype-directed planning; do not assume imatinib sensitivity.

recommendation.title: Resectable GIST with significant morbidity and nonstandard/unknown genotype: expert multidisciplinary genotype-directed planning; do not assume imatinib sensitivity.

postop_adj.label: Postoperative GIST with meaningful recurrence risk: adjuvant genotype-sensitive therapy and surveillance per GIST-3.

recommendation.title: Postoperative GIST with meaningful recurrence risk: adjuvant genotype-sensitive therapy and surveillance per GIST-3.

options.label: Adjuvant therapy
options.text: Use genotype/risk-directed adjuvant therapy when sensitive; duration per source risk/therapy principles.

postop_surv.label: Postoperative very-low/low-risk GIST: surveillance pathway; adjuvant therapy is not automatically indicated.

recommendation.title: Postoperative very-low/low-risk GIST: surveillance pathway; adjuvant therapy is not automatically indicated.

unres_primary.label: Unresectable or metastatic GIST: initiate genotype-directed TKI therapy and assess response/resectability.

recommendation.title: Unresectable or metastatic GIST: initiate genotype-directed TKI therapy and assess response/resectability.

options.label: Local therapy in selected response
options.text: Consider resection/ablation when source criteria are met.

unres_continue.label: Unresectable/metastatic GIST with response or stable disease: continue active TKI and reassess for local therapy when appropriate.

recommendation.title: Unresectable/metastatic GIST with response or stable disease: continue active TKI and reassess for local therapy when appropriate.

options.label: Continue active therapy
options.text: Continue source-appropriate TKI while benefiting; use imaging principles.

prog_limited.label: Limited GIST progression: integrate local control with line-appropriate systemic therapy.

recommendation.title: Limited GIST progression: integrate local control with line-appropriate systemic therapy.

options.label: Local control
options.text: Surgery/ablation/RT when feasible for limited progression.

options.label: Systemic line change
options.text: Switch/continue TKI according to prior exposure and genotype.

prog_wide.label: Widespread GIST progression: change to next line of genotype/prior-exposure appropriate systemic therapy; supportive/local palliation as needed.

recommendation.title: Widespread GIST progression: change to next line of genotype/prior-exposure appropriate systemic therapy; supportive/local palliation as needed.

options.label: Next-line systemic therapy
options.text: Use GIST-E line-specific therapy based on prior exposure/genotype.
